test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.

Peterkin readjusted his hat and soon was listening to the conversation with __as much interest__ as I was.
solution:
The correct answer is '**option 4'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is correct, so there is '**no substitution required**'.
 
• Thus, the correct alternative is- **option 4)**.

**The correct sentence: **Peterkin readjusted his hat and soon was listening to the conversation with ***as much interest__****** as*** I was.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• The phrase - 'as much as' is used when **two things are equal in amount**.

 
 
• **Example- **John likes caramel** *as much as* **chocolate fudge.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

 
• The phrase - '**Much as**' is often confused with '**as much as'**, but '**much as**' conveys different meaning.
 
• '**Much as**' means **although** or **even though**.
 
 
• 
 
**Example- ****Much as** he wanted to stay at the party, she had to leave for the office.
